items.heading: Domoda
details: Key ingredients: peanut butter, meat, tomato, sweet potato
Brown meat with onion and tomato.
Stir in peanut butter and enough water to form a sauce.
Add chunks of sweet potato and simmer until tender.
Cook until the sauce is thick and glossy, then serve with rice.

items.heading: Benachin
details: Key ingredients: rice, fish, tomato, vegetables, palm oil
Brown fish pieces and set aside.
Saute tomato, onion and vegetables in palm oil.
Add rice and water, layering the fish back on top.
Cover and cook until the rice absorbs all the flavorful liquid.

items.heading: Yassa
details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.
Prepare and cut the main ingredients.
Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.
